title: 5 Reasons You Can’t Miss the Partner Forum at Pure Accelerate London
summary: EMEA strategy, honest partner conversations, and direct access to leadership—see why partners shouldn’t miss the Partner Forum at Pure Accelerate London.
body_markdown:
### Summary


Ahead of Pure Accelerate London, this article walks through what’s on the agenda for this year’s Partner Forum, from a live partner fireside chat to an alliance panel on regulation, the Pan EMEA Awards, and direct access to leadership in an open Q&A. It also features video commentary from Craig Robertson, AVP of EMEA and LATAM Partner Sales, sharing five reasons EMEA partners can’t afford to miss the day.


Ready to hear what’s next for Everpure EMEA partner strategy, straight from the people deciding it? This September, at the Partner Forum during Pure Accelerate London, partners get a direct line to the priorities, product direction, and partner experience shaping the year ahead, live and in person.


That’s the difference the Partner Forum makes.


On Tuesday, September 29, ahead of the main Pure Accelerate London keynotes and breakouts, partners across EMEA will get a full day built specifically for them—no filters, no follow-up required. Here’s what to expect and why it’s worth clearing your calendar for.


## **What’s on the agenda**


The Partner Forum runs as a dedicated track within Pure Accelerate London, and it’s packed. A few highlights:


**Welcome and framing** , from the top. Ricardo Moreno, VP of Global Partner Sales, opens the day by setting the tone and framing what partners can expect to walk away with.


**A first look at what’s next.** Michael Leworthy, Senior Director of Product Marketing, gives partners an exclusive look at new announcements ahead of the broader Pure Accelerate London keynotes—details partners will hear here first.


**EMEA strategy and priorities** , straight from leadership. Craig Robertson, AVP of EMEA and LATAM Partner Sales, opens the strategic conversation with a direct look at where the region is headed and what’s driving the priorities for the year ahead.


**A live partner proof point.** Rather than offering a polished case study, Everpure CMO Lynn Lucas sits down for a candid fireside chat with one of our partners to talk through what’s actually working, and what isn’t, in the field.


**An alliance panel that gets ahead of the curve.** Mark Bridges, Head of Strategic Alliances, is joined by leaders from CrowdStrike, Commvault, and Kyndryl for a conversation on how regulation is reshaping the competitive landscape and how partners can turn that shift into an advantage rather than a headache.


**A practical look at partner experience.** Cheri Schumacher, AVP of Global Partner Programs and Experience, walks through what’s changing to reduce friction and improve margin, backed by live demos.


**Recognition that matters.** The day builds to the Pan EMEA Awards, celebrating the partners driving real results across the region, presented by Craig Robertson, Ricardo Moreno, and Seb Darrington.


**Direct access to leadership.** The Partner Forum closes with an open floor, live Q&A—no script, no filter—just a chance to ask leadership the questions that matter to your business.


## **Top 5 reasons to attend**


We sat down with Craig Robertson ahead of the event to talk about why this year’s Partner Forum is one EMEA partners shouldn’t miss. Here’s what he had to say:


As Craig put it:“ *Those in the room on September 29 will be the ones who know what to do next.* ”


## **Save Your Seat**


The Partner Forum is one day, but it’s part of something bigger. Stick around through September 30 for the rest of Pure Accelerate London, keynotes, PEAK training and certification exams, the expo floor, and breakout sessions built to help you turn a day onsite into immediate value for your business.


[Register for Pure Accelerate London →](https://purecommunity.purestorage.com/event/pure-accelerate-events/pureaccelerate-london/4157)


We’ll see you in London.


— Tom Ayres, Global Partner Content and Communications Manager, Everpure
